mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_demands (user_id, category_id, keyword, min_price, max_price, condition_level, delivery_options, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{keyword}, #{minPrice}, #{maxPrice}, #{conditionLevel}, #{deliveryOptions}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, category_id, keyword, min_price, max_price, condition_level, delivery_options, status, create_time FROM product_demands WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM product_demands WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, category_id, keyword, min_price, max_price, condition_level, delivery_options, status, create_time FROM product_demands WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND user_id != #{sellerId} AND (category_id IS NULL OR category_id = #{categoryId}) AND (min_price IS NULL OR min_price <= #{price}) AND (max_price IS NULL OR max_price >= #{price}) AND (condition_level IS NULL OR condition_level <= #{conditionLevel}) AND (delivery_options IS NULL OR delivery_options = '' OR #{deliveryOptions} LIKE CONCAT('%', delivery_options, '%')) AND (keyword IS NULL OR keyword = '' OR (#{title} LIKE CONCAT('%', keyword, '%') OR #{description} LIKE CONCAT('%', keyword, '%')))
